notes: The ER evaluation set for T-022 acceptance 1: 'precision >= configured floor and GTIN
matches always link'. Ground truth read in ONE direction — the resolver is graded
against these labels and never writes them, so a change that lowers quality shows up as
a failing gate rather than as a regenerated fixture.
Each pair carries `same` (the truth) and `why` (what the pair is testing). The records
are the shape services/ingest/src/er reads: product_id, gtin, canonical_name, brand.
product_id values are shaped like the real graph's (mapping.product_id_for), and the
two sides of every pair come from DIFFERENT stores, because that is the case the ticket
exists for: one trade item, two storefronts, two Product nodes.
GTINs here are REAL: every one that is meant to be usable carries a valid GS1 modulo-10
check digit, and the two deliberately-broken ones are labelled as such. A fixture full
of made-up barcode numbers would grade a resolver that ignores the check digit as
equivalent to one that honours it.

pairs.why: Same GTIN, different encodings (UPC-A vs GTIN-14) and an untranslatable name. Identity must beat text.
Same GTIN written with the hyphen separators a printed barcode uses.
EAN-8 zero-pads to the same GTIN-14 as its 14-digit rendering.
No GTIN either side; identical product under a plural and a brand suffix.
Same product, word order and punctuation differ, brands identical.
Accents and case only. One storefront types the accent, the other does not.
Two different trade items, both carrying valid but different GTINs. The strongest negative signal in commerce data.
Unrelated products, unrelated brands. The pair the frozen acceptance test refuses at 0.9.
Same brand, same product line, different product. Brand agreement must not carry a pair on its own.
Same category word, different model. One token of a three-token title differing is not a match.
Identical titles, different manufacturers. A generic product name is not an identity.
Both GTINs are the unset-field placeholder, so they are not identifiers and must not link two different products.
Neither side has a name. Two nameless records are an absence of evidence, not a match.
A knock-off evading resolution with a Cyrillic homoglyph. Folding it is what keeps the evasion from working.
Same GTIN but one side's check digit is wrong, so it is not an identifier. The names and brands still agree, so the pair links on similarity.
